headline: Approved motor vehicle excise tax abatements and statutory exemptions; FY27 certification letters sent to property owners.
summary: The meeting covered tax abatements, exemption applications, and FY27 certification. Members unanimously approved the prior minutes, abatement applications, and exemption applications. Letters with the FY27 adjustments were sent to property owners on 10/07/2026.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the September 29, 2026 meetings, unanimously.
Approved motor vehicle excise abatements for the week of September 21 to September 25 by signatures.
Approved three motor vehicle excise abatement applications listed for denial, unanimously.
Approved statutory exemption and Veteran Volunteer applications, unanimously.
Sent FY27 certification letters with the adjustments to property owners on 10/07/2026.

transcript:
# MINUTES

## THE MEETING OF THE BOARD OF ASSESSORS

LOWELL MA    October 15, 2026

A meeting of the Board of Assessors took place on October 8, 2026, at 9:30 AM in Room 36 at Lowell City Hall:

In attendance: Chief Assessor; E. Brideau, Assessor; A. Lombardo

1. Review of minutes from September 29, 2026 meetings – E. Brideau made a motion to approve the minutes, A. Lombardo 2nd – Unanimous.

2. Applications for MOTOR VEHICLE EXCISE TAX ABATEMENTS (supporting documentation attached to each application)
   - Motor Vehicle Excise Abatements
     - Week of September 21 to September 25 – Approved by signatures
     - Week of September 28 to October 2
     - MVE Abatements for denial – 3 applications; A. Lombardo motion to approve, E. Brideau 2nd – Unanimous.

3. Statutory Exemptions – Clause 17E: 1 application, 37A: 1 application, Clause 41C: 1 application, and 1 Veteran Volunteer application – A. Lombardo made a motion to approve these applications, E. Brideau 2nd – Unanimous.

4. FY27 Certification – letters with the adjustments were sent to property owners on 10/07/2026

5. New Business – None

6. Old Business – None

Motion to adjourn at 9:38 AM E. Brideau, A. Lombardo 2nd – Unanimous.

Respectfully submitted,

Chornai Pech

Administrative Assistant
